source_body_latin: Domine Jesu Christe, qui dixisti Apostolis tuis: Pacem relinquo vobis, pacem meam do vobis: ne respicias peccata mea, sed fidem Ecclesiae tuae: eamque secundum voluntatem tuam pacificare et coadunare digneris:
source_revision: In the old prayer body, replace only the singular possessive mea with plural nostra, as directly witnessed at secondary2002 n126. This is substantive communal perspective, not orthography. Replace the whole old conclusion with the separately witnessed whole short conclusion; neither change is hidden.
source_conclusion_latin: Qui vivis et regnas in saecula saeculorum.
english: Lord Jesus Christ, who said to your Apostles, “I leave peace with you; I give you my peace”: do not regard our sins, but the faith of your Church; and according to your will, be pleased to grant her peace and bring her together in unity. You who live and reign for ever and ever.

source_revision: Modern people response is independently assigned by secondary2002 n126, not inferred from the older priest-prayer Amen.
